verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes its own machine-readable API reference: probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json, plus markdown docs and llms.txt. The Agent API also has quickstart and building-agents documentation. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer (a 'try it' playground) or examples that can be run from the reference. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable/executable examples within the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
